explanation: For each remaining interval, compare taking its left or right coin. The opponent forces the smaller of the two resulting future revenues, so maximize that guaranteed revenue and memoize interval results.
timeComplexity: O(n^2) time when memoized positive-revenue states are computed once; O(3^n) is a safe bound if zero-revenue states repeat.
spaceComplexity: O(n^2) memo space and O(n) recursion depth.
